objects.name: big
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE big (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, body TEXT, data BLOB)

objects.name: events
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE events (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  ty INTEGER NOT NULL,
  status INTEGER NOT NULL,
  source INTEGER REFERENCES events(id),
  body TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
)

objects.name: note_tags
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE note_tags (note TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES notes(id), owner TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (note, owner, name), FOREIGN KEY (owner, name) REFERENCES tags(owner, name))

objects.name: notes
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE notes (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('memo', 'todo', 'log')))

objects.name: notes_fts
objects.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE notes_fts USING fts5(body, content='notes')

objects.name: notes_fts_config
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE 'notes_fts_config'(k PRIMARY KEY, v) WITHOUT ROWID

objects.name: notes_fts_data
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE 'notes_fts_data'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, block BLOB)

objects.name: notes_fts_docsize
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE 'notes_fts_docsize'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sz BLOB)

objects.name: notes_fts_idx
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE 'notes_fts_idx'(segid, term, pgno, PRIMARY KEY(segid, term)) WITHOUT ROWID

objects.name: tags
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE tags (owner TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, n INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (owner, name)) WITHOUT ROWID

objects.name: a_notes_touch
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER a_notes_touch AFTER UPDATE ON notes BEGIN UPDATE notes SET updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = new.id; END

objects.name: a_open_todo_count
objects.sql: CREATE VIEW a_open_todo_count AS SELECT count(*) AS n FROM open_todos

objects.name: open_todos
objects.sql: CREATE VIEW open_todos AS SELECT id, body FROM notes WHERE kind = 'todo'
